objective: Replace unreliable same-model self-approval with a measured independent claim-to-evidence validation and linking stage, using task 221 failures and supported outputs without regenerating the old matrix or relaxing support gates.
instructions:
Task 221 produced unsupported eligible wrong-neighbor, vermicast/compost role-transfer and codification and Barcelona temporal-role claims, while its same-model audit also rejected a source-supported Athens explanation for missing exact question wording. Preserve all immutable 60 drafts, historical wrapper audits, model pins and builder labels as regression inputs; do not generate repeated old answers to search for better wording. Use the same Qwen3 4B host candidate SHA 7485fe6f11af29433bc51cab58009521f205840f5b4ae3a32fa7f92e8534fdf5 for genuinely new draft cases only, never relabel it deployed.
Freeze at least 16 new public discriminating source-faithful cases across four reviewed topics before verifier/model changes, with supported paraphrases and minimally altered wrong-subject, input/output, condition, temporal, negation, numeric/formula and false-premise claims, including a supported correction that mentions and negates a false premise, and a compound answer with a supported main sentence and an unsupported or self-contradictory tail. Label constructed counterfactual fixtures as tests, never corpus facts. Pin exact source spans and expected judgments before inference. Compare the existing same-model audit with one licensed independently trained discriminative textual-entailment model (at most 1 GiB artifact) under a predeclared fixed threshold and token/admission policy. Record immutable revision, full license, hash, raw scores, truncation/failure handling and real local runtime identity. Do not equate an entailment classifier label, exact quote or word overlap with acceptance: source-inspect all eligible prose and retain false approvals/rejections.
Derive citation candidates only from actual available edition-aware spans; test whether independent scoring can reject/rebind task 221 wrong-neighbor references without rewriting facts. Check every generated factual clause, subject and material conditions, not only the central answer. Preserve obligation/subject context in the final renderer: task 221 n08 hid the Athens subject and rendered It immediately after Barcelona. Evaluate final rendered prose as well as typed metadata; do not silently substitute hidden metadata for an explicit supported antecedent. Do not silently drop unsupported extra sentences or give a selected quote credit for an unsupported paraphrase. Treat absent questions separately from supported corrections of false premises, so a W label alone is not proof of either inability or usefulness. Preserve all old eight absent controls and the new absent control. Formula/article brackets must remain text; typed links must retain exact source offsets, rights, dates and hashes.
Use existing 60 drafts for the old comparison, and exactly one new 4B draft per newly frozen question. Keep 4096 host context tokens and 512 total autoregressive generated tokens per new question, with every stage/budget declared in advance; no seed/prompt/threshold search against failed cases. Report support, completeness, usefulness and route separately. Require zero unsupported eligible answers across old/new/regression populations, all absent controls withheld and more than 4/40 fully supported complete useful old answers retained; preserve a negative result if no independently verified improvement is achieved. Add behavior/integrity tests using actual changed/missing verifier/model/run artifacts, namespace and cancellation cases. Keep production model.env and Android model/context admission unchanged; selected-model Android integration remains a separate measured gate in an approved sufficiently provisioned environment. Any new verifier adds to the future model/memory/installed budget and must be measured on the host without claiming phone suitability. No private holdout, service changes, network inference, global model preferences, publication or main advancement. Run serial bounded rig jobs; retain raw failures and update findings/release gaps. Queue only the precise next independent product step justified by the result.
